title: refactor: give the inferred-return-type public methods on the engine.ts and protocol.ts facades explicit return types (.d.ts unchanged), so the codemod can move their bodies
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: the maintainer asked for this on PR #30012 at 2026-11-04T10:03Z (「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」). The facades are merged: engine.ts as 237f5137 (#30012) and protocol.ts as 48914fdc (#29998). Estimates come from the #29986 / #29985 dev reports. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane (devx or server).

Business reason: bodies whose public return type is inferred stay on the class as #30019 exceptions, because moving them would change the `.d.ts` re-inference. In `engine.ts` there are 8: `registerApp`, `registerHook`, `registerDriver`, `init`, `triggerHooks`, `destroy`, `setDatasourceMapping` and `getStatus`, 491 lines in all. In `protocol.ts` they include `getDiscovery` (460), `findData` (751), `getData` (75), `cloneData` (105) and the four `*MetaItem` doors. Writing each return type explicitly, equal to what is inferred today, lets the codemod move the body.
Reader who acts: `packages/objectql` / `packages/metadata-protocol` owners.

## What to do
- Spell each return type explicitly, and prove the public `.d.ts` is byte-equal before and after. That is one PR with no behaviour change.
- Then re-run the codemod so the bodies move, and drop their rows from the #30019 allow-list.
Dedupe: `inferred return type facade`, `30019 exception`. **New.**
